description: This file defines the AppIdentityDbContext class, which extends IdentityDbContext for managing identity-related data with Entity Framework in an ASP.NET Core application. It is used for configuring the database context for user identity storage.

classes.name: AppIdentityDbContext
classes.description: A custom Entity Framework database context for handling identity data, extends IdentityDbContext with ApplicationUser as the user entity.

methods.name: AppIdentityDbContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DbContext with the provided options.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Overrides the method to customize the model creation process for the Identity framework.
